about: Which layer catches which fault. caught = the layer reports something on the fault variant that it does not report on the clean Cabinet. Layers: XSD and semantic = x3d_mcp validators at 13121b6; lab_shacl = shapes/x3d-lab.shacl.ttl (pyshacl); core_shacl = the bundled x3d-core shapes through the real shacl_validate tool at 7d3f1d5; sparql = one detection query per fault (stations_spec.DETECT); render = X_ITE 16.5.1 screenshots vs the clean Cabinet; reasoner = owlrl OWL 2 RL closure (inconsistency messages or owl:Nothing members). Grade C for every cell: each is a measurement named by its source.
